responsibility: This module is the GCC target backend for the Fujitsu FR30 architecture, covering the machine-specific code-generation layer that turns GCC’s generic RTL into FR30 assembly while enforcing the FR30 ABI, register set, and instruction encoding rules. Its core header and implementation files define the port’s architectural properties, data layout, register classes, calling convention, argument and return handling, stack-frame layout, frame-pointer elimination, prologue/epilogue generation, trampoline support, and helper routines for operand printing and awkward multiword moves; its machine-description, predicate, and constraint files provide the declarative instruction patterns, delay-slot and length attributes, operand recognizers, and legal operand classes that drive instruction selection, reload, scheduling, and final emission; and its option files expose FR30-specific command-line switches such as small-model and simulator-link behavior. Together these file families distinguish the module as the complete backend responsible for FR30-specific lowering, validation, and assembly emission, rather than generic optimization or front-end language semantics.
